name: comp-280
description: Toast-style error notification with a close button for manual dismissal. Designed for temporary error message display in toast stacks.
use_when: Displaying temporary error feedback to users via toast notifications. Great for API errors or async operation failures.
avoid_when: Critical errors requiring user acknowledgment. State that must persist until resolved.
a11y: Close button lacks accessible label. Parent toast container should provide role='alert' and aria-live='assertive'.
